title: LidarBC Data Availability
summary: Explore the annual footprints of publicly available provincial LiDAR data, then continue to LidarBC to select and download point clouds and elevation products.
sourceNote: This project is a cartographic snapshot of the public LidarBC Provincial Data Extent service, last edited in July 2026. It stores 13 simplified annual availability footprints—not the LiDAR point clouds, DEMs, DSMs, or tile-level download indexes. Annual footprints can overlap where an area was surveyed more than once, so their areas must not be added together as a province-wide coverage percentage. Use the official portal for current tile selection and downloads.
details: Click or tap a footprint for its acquisition year and source-reported area.
LidarBC provides classified point clouds, digital elevation models, digital surface models, and other derived products through its download portal.
The Province's six-year collection program is intended to make LiDAR products available for all of B.C. by 2029.

scenes.text: The service currently contains annual availability footprints for 2011 and every year from 2015 through 2026. Newer surveys are drawn above older footprints where coverage overlaps.

scenes.label: Recent collection
scenes.title: The largest published annual footprint is from 2024
scenes.text: Collection accelerated after the Province announced its six-year program in 2023. The 2024 source footprint covers about 160,350 square kilometres before accounting for overlaps with other years.

scenes.label: Downloads
scenes.title: Tile-level products remain in the official portal
scenes.text: The live service indexes 160,334 point-cloud tiles, 94,607 DSM tiles, and 95,028 DEM tiles. PGMaps keeps only the lightweight overview; use LidarBC to select files, inspect metadata, and download products.
